text.en: SayCan is row 117 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Robots area.
text.zh: SayCan 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 117 行，所属领域为“机器人”。

text.en: The annual table associates SayCan with “Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances”.
text.zh: 年度表把 SayCan 与论文《Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is blank.
SayCan uses language-model planning multiplied by learned affordance values.
text.zh: SayCan 采用语言模型规划与学习到的可供性价值相乘。

text.en: Experts generally treat SayCan as an early and influential blueprint for combining foundation models with embodied control rather than letting language models act as unconstrained planners. Its usefulness-feasibility split reappears in later vision-language-action and robotic agent systems.
text.zh: 专家通常把 SayCan 视为基础模型与具身控制结合的早期重要蓝图，而不是让语言模型不受约束地规划。它对“有用性”和“可行性”的拆分，后来反复出现在视觉-语言-动作模型和机器人智能体中。
